title: ticfac run's herdr panes drop runners.toml effort, args and socket: run-epic builds executorFactory with an empty gate path
body: run never forwards --gate, and cli.go:339 captures *fl.gate ("") in executorFactory before reconcile defaults GateConfig to .tick/runners.toml. spawnArgv reads "", treats ENOENT as 'routes nothing', and launches claude without effort, pi without the --approve init writes, and at the default socket even when orchestration.socket is where run detected herdr. Pre-existing in executor.go, but ticfac run makes it the default path.
